title: 14th Heidelberg Laureate Forum
about: Application for young researchers in mathematics and computer science (undergraduate/pre-master, PhD and postdoc) to attend the 14th Heidelberg Laureate Forum, 12-17 September 2027 (subject to change). The application window runs from 11 November 2026 to 11 February 2027.
